messages:
Maria P: Quick heads-up — Polaris Systems and CloudVendor marketplace go-live next week. We need a final partner SEV handoff flow. Proposing a dedicated shared channel + a lightweight war-room runbook.
Kevin SRE: +1. Can we reuse /shared-partner-sev pattern? avoids extra bots.
Li W: For sales engs: we need clarity on who we loop in for SLA vs hardware failure. Polaris will expect HW vendor triage first.
Dave P: Proposed flow: 1) customer reports -> Polaris triage (hw) -> if app-level or infra, Redwood on-call -> shared channel + bridge.
Janet Support: Need a clear on-call list + escalation times. Support will own initial contact until 15m, then escalate to SRE.
Sandeep M: Marketplace ops need a soft-fallback: if listing issues cause customer errors, we want CloudVendor engaged in the first 10 minutes.
Maria P: Draft channel name: #partner-polaris-cloudvendor-sev. Permissions: Polaris external guest + CloudVendor guest + our oncall alias. Thoughts?
Kevin SRE: Works. Add an emergency webhook to create a temporary war-room in infra if latency > threshold.
infra-bot: Deploy note: new channel template created at /ops/templates/partner-warroom. To provision run:
```
./provision-warroom --partner polaris --marketplace cloudvendor --ttl 8h
```
Kevin SRE: We'll add SLO triggers: if 95th latency > 500ms for 3 consecutive minutes on marketplace proxy, auto-flag and notify channel.
Janet Support: Can we add a one-click escalation card for support agents? Something that posts the minimal diagnostics and pings SRE + Polaris.
Dave P: Agree. Minimal diag = customer id, request-id, timestamp, full curl (sanitized). keep it to 5 fields.
Li W: I'll own the Polaris contact tree doc + make sure Polaris provides a named engineer for the launch window.
Sandeep M: I'll sync with CloudVendor to confirm they can join the shared channel as guest and accept incident pings.
Maria P: Action items so far: Li — Polaris contact + named engineer (by EOD), Sandeep — CloudVendor guest provisioning (by EOD), Kevin — add SLO trigger + webhook (tomorrow AM), Janet — escalation card prototype (tomorrow).
Kevin SRE: Also recommend a warm-warroom drill 1 day before launch (15 min run). Validate perms and bridge.
Janet Support: I'll schedule the drill and invite Polaris/CloudVendor contacts.
Dave P: Draft runbook link: https://docs.redwood.ai/partners/polaris-marketplace-sev-runbook (WIP). Please add comments on roles/handback.
Maria P: Thanks team. If no objections I'll spin up the channel and runbook tonight. :thumbsup:
Li W: No objections. Thanks.
Sandeep M: ✅
Kevin SRE: LGTM
Janet Support: :white_check_mark:
Maria P: I'll post back when channel & runbook are live.
